title: Ability to access "transcripts" after a session
body: We'd like to get a "chat transcript" (ideally including tool calls) after each session. We'd use that to improve our prompting (by showing Claude the transcript and asking it where our prompts were bad)
author: jonastemplestein

top_comments.author: wolffiex
top_comments.body:
Of course you can do what you want with your data, but we don't recommend building anything on top of the structure as it currently is in ~/.claude

This is still changing and we make no guarantee about the format or content. A supported log feature does make sense, but isn't a priority for us right now.

top_comments.author: junoatwork
top_comments.body: I'd also love this. In addition to #371 to save the session for CC, keeping transcripts is super helpful for sharing successful sessions with colleagues to learn by example. Simonw's `llm` [logs by default](https://llm.datasette.io/en/stable/logging.html), for example, which enables some more [cool post-hoc usecases](https://llm.datasette.io/en/stable/logging.html).
